art_instructions: Compose a wide, low-to-the-ground scene of the family cottage exterior on a bright, sunny day, viewed slightly upward from a child’s vantage. Place the open front door on the right third of the image with the door swinging outward; creamy white walls, sage-green shutters, a terracotta roof edge, and a white‑washed stone foundation are visible, with a tiny two-step porch leading to a cobblestone path. Put Owl at the threshold, mid-hop as she leaves the house: one foot just off the porch step, wings partly open as if beginning to glide forward, body angled toward the left along the path, head turned outward with a gentle smile and bright, round eyes. She wears her small green scarf and a tiny cross‑body satchel; no lantern (full daytime). Keep Owl chibi-proportioned and about one quarter of the frame height, centered slightly right of center so her movement to the left is clear. Show warm, dim interior tones just inside the doorway behind her, and stronger sunlight outside with a soft, short shadow on the path in front of her. Flank the path on the left with simple sunflowers and lavender clumps; add a couple of tiny butterflies near the flowers for life, but keep backgrounds simple and airy. Use flat pastels, clean monoline strokes, and minimal cel shading; avoid any text or signage.
